result.summary: The page looks mostly functional with no critical visual breaks. One minor notification indicator issue was observed.

issues.description: The notification bell/icon in the top-right corner appears to be a plain grey circle with a red dot, but lacks a recognizable icon glyph (e.g., bell icon), making it unclear what it represents or that it is interactive.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the icon inside the circular button is rendered correctly — the bell or notification icon may be missing or failed to load.
